residency_notes: Arcee's privacy policy points to a separate data-retention policy and describes service-provider processing, but the reviewed public materials do not specify an API execution/storage region or a Zero Data Retention control. Paid and unpaid training controls are separate from retention.
prompt_training_notes: Arcee AI says inputs and outputs from unpaid services may be used to train and improve its services unless the user opts out by contacting support. It says paid-service inputs and outputs are not used for training by default, with safety-review and explicitly reported-content exceptions.
